title: The insect effector CSPs activate an atypical plant TNL immune receptor.
authors: Rao, Weiwei; Li, Tianzhu; Yang, Jing; Zhu, Liwen; Zhao, Wei; Ma, Tingting
one_liner_zh: 该文研究昆虫效应子CSP激活植物TNL免疫受体RCSP的结构与催化机制，使用AlphaFold3/DMFold建模和分子对接等计算手段，但核心对象是植物免疫受体而非通用蛋白质结构计算问题，方法贡献偏向应用。
abstract: CSP-mediated activation of RCSP involves noncanonical structural and catalytic mechanisms-including BB-loop deletion, alpha5alpha6-loop insertion, and atypical catalytic residues within the RCSP-TIR domain. Chemosensory proteins (CSPs), a conserved effector family in phloem-feeding insects such as aphids and the brown planthopper (Nilaparvata lugens), induce dwarfism in Nicotiana benthamiana through recognition by the Toll-interleukin-1 receptor (TIR) domain-containing nucleotide-binding leucine-rich repeat receptor (TNL) RCSP. However, CSP-mediated RCSP activation and enzymatic mechanism remain unknown. Here, we show that TIR domain of RCSP (RCSP-TIR) exhibits unique features, including a 9-amino acid deletion in the loop between beta-strand B and alpha-helix B (BB-loop), an 8-amino acid insertion in the loop between alpha5 and alpha6 (alpha5alpha6-loop), and substitution of the canonical catalytic glutamate with glutamine (E87Q). Structural analysis demonstrates that BB-loop deletion disrupts the canonical NAD(+)-binding pocket and prevents standard TIR tetramerization. Strikingly, AlphaFold3/DMFold modeling reveals that RCSP compensates via alpha5alpha6-loop insertion, forming a novel interface that stabilizes an atypical tetrameric architecture. Integrated approaches combining molecular docking and site-directed mutagenesis demonstrate that RCSP may utilize a noncanonical NAD(+)-binding pocket and depend on dual catalytic residues (D86/Q87) to mediate weak cell death. Evolutionary analysis classifies RCSP-TIR homologs into four distinct clades, highlighting Solanaceae-specific adaptations. These findings elucidate a novel plant-insect interaction mechanism in which RCSP's structural diversification enables CSPs recognition and immune signaling reprogramming.
abstract_zh: CSP介导的RCSP激活涉及非经典的结构和催化机制——包括BB-loop缺失、alpha5alpha6-loop插入以及RCSP-TIR结构域内的非典型催化残基。化学感受蛋白（chemosensory proteins, CSPs）是蚜虫和褐飞虱（Nilaparvata lugens）等韧皮部取食昆虫中一个保守的效应子家族，通过被含Toll-白细胞介素-1受体（TIR）结构域的核苷酸结合富亮氨酸重复受体（TNL）RCSP识别，诱导本氏烟（Nicotiana benthamiana）矮化。然而，CSP介导的RCSP激活及其酶学机制仍不清楚。在此，我们表明RCSP的TIR结构域（RCSP-TIR）展现出独特特征，包括β链B和α螺旋B之间环（BB-loop）中9个氨基酸的缺失、α5和α6之间环（alpha5alpha6-loop）中8个氨基酸的插入，以及典型催化谷氨酸被谷氨酰胺取代（E87Q）。结构分析表明，BB-loop缺失破坏了经典的NAD(+)结合口袋，并阻止了标准TIR四聚化。引人注目的是，AlphaFold3/DMFold建模揭示RCSP通过alpha5alpha6-loop插入进行补偿，形成一个新的界面，稳定了一种非典型的四聚体架构。结合分子对接和定点诱变的综合方法表明，RCSP可能利用一个非经典的NAD(+)结合口袋，并依赖双催化残基（D86/Q87）介导微弱的细胞死亡。进化分析将RCSP-TIR同源物分为四个不同的分支，突出了茄科特异性适应。这些发现阐明了一种新型的植物-昆虫互作机制，其中RCSP的结构多样化使其能够识别CSPs并重编程免疫信号。
